notes: Hotmail/Outlook manager now built into the tool on every PC: right-click an account - Hotmail - View IMAP / Just Login / Check Token / Change Password / Add Recovery / Open Browser, all run on the account's own Email/Pass/Recovery columns using its Android user-agent + proxy, with a live per-step Status Detail trace. A failed login now shows the real reason (e.g. 'Proxy dead / connect failed') in Status Detail instead of staying stuck on 'Opening login page'.
